input.title: Resolve #101: tenancy@1 commit no longer reports an unconfirmed commit as CONFLICT
input.message:
Resolve #101: map FeltDB errors in TenancyTransaction.commit()

Only PRECONDITION_FAILED becomes CONFLICT ("nothing was written").
COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and DURABILITY_FAILURE become OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with a
hint to read before retrying; other FeltDB refusals go through feltdbRefusal,
anything else is rethrown unchanged.
input.body:
Resolves #101.

## What changed
- `packages/appboundry-host/src/tenancy.ts`: `TenancyTransaction.commit()` used to turn every error from `db.transaction()` into `CONFLICT` with the message "nothing was written". It now maps errors the way `collections.ts` `commitError` does:
  - `PRECONDITION_FAILED` → `CONFLICT` ("nothing was written"), same message as before.
  - `COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` / `DURABILITY_FAILURE` → `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, with a hint to read the tenant and membership records before retrying.
  - Other FeltDB refusals → `feltdbRefusal()` (UNAVAILABLE / INTERNAL / contract-changed CONFLICT). Any other error is rethrown unchanged.
- `packages/appboundry-host/test/tenancy-commit-outcome.test.ts`: the regression test from the issue.

## Test results
- New test against **base**: **failed** on its assertion (`expected 'CONFLICT' not to be 'CONFLICT'`), 1 failed.
- New test against **change**: **passed** (1/1).
- Existing `packages/appboundry-host/test/tenancy.test.ts` against **change**: **passed** (7/7).
- `build` (tsc -b) on change: passed.

## Not done
- The issue also suggests passing a stable `transactionId` so FeltDB can deduplicate a resend. That is not in this PR, to keep the change minimal. It can be a follow-up.
- Errors that are not FeltDB errors are now rethrown as they are, not wrapped as CONFLICT.
